biotools.summary: SpliceMutr is a bioinformatics pipeline for identifying splicing-derived neoantigens from tumor and normal data, facilitating the prediction of MHC-binding affinity and estimation of antigenicity scores. The tool is openly available and has been applied to analyze splicing antigenicity in cancer immunotherapy cohorts.
